mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing progesterone levels and effects; progesterone may theoretically enhance amiodarone's cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased progesterone side effects (breakthrough bleeding, nausea, mood changes) and amiodarone efficacy; consider progesterone dose adjustment if needed; counsel on potential reduced contraceptive efficacy in some scenarios.
